title: Vintage Stained Glass Window Panel (w Art Deco Geometric Design)
description: For sale is a vintage stained glass window panel with Art Deco geometric design. This circa 1950s architectural salvaged piece is set in a solid wood frame. This stained glass panel represents the Art Deco design movement that flourished from the 1920s through the 1930s. The geometric pattern with its fan-like arches and bold color blocking is characteristic of the period's emphasis on symmetry and stylized forms. Such panels were commonly installed in residential homes as decorative transoms, door inserts, or small accent windows during the interwar period. Stained glass panels from this era are highly sought after by collectors of architectural salvage, Art Deco enthusiasts, and homeowners restoring period properties. These pieces appeal to interior designers and vintage decor collectors who appreciate the craftsmanship of hand-leaded glass and the warm, colorful light they cast into living spaces. The geometric simplicity and compact size make them versatile decorative elements that can be displayed as wall art or reinstalled as functional windows.
